propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Deus, qui novum per beatam Angelam sacrarum Virginum collegium in Ecclesia
tua florescere voluisti: da nobis, ejus intercessione, angelicis moribus
vivere; ut, terrenis omnibus abdicatis, gaudiis perfrui mereamur aeternis.
Per Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum, Filium tuum: Qui tecum vivit et regnat
in unitate.

translations.caution:
A lay hand missal of the 1945 revision, printed about 1955-56, not an approved liturgical translation and never an altar book. Its Holy Week is the pre-1955 rite, its sanctoral is not the 1962 sanctoral, and its second and third orations are not those of 1962. It is carried only where a 1962 formulary is the same prayer, and nothing here may be used for recitation.

Leaf n1023, printed p. 1031, under `Prayer` in the 1 June Mass of St Angela Merici. The page prints the complete facing Latin and English with Angela's name. This exact sanctoral setting reads `flourish`; the separate particular-places setting reading `blossom` is not used.
translations.source_label: The New Roman Missal in Latin and English, revised edition, by F. X. Lasance and Francis Augustine Walsh (New York: Benziger Brothers, 1945), ca. 1955-56 printing (Internet Archive delivery locator fr-lasance-missal-1937; locator mislabelled)
translations.text: O God, Who hast willed that, through blessed Angela, a new family of consecrated virgins should flourish in Thy Church, grant us, through her intercession, to lead an angelic life, that, putting aside all earthly joys, we may deserve to attain those that are eternal. Through our Lord.

propers.name: Secret
propers.text:
Hostia, Domine, quam tibi beatae Angelae memoriam recolentes offerimus, et
nostrae pravitatis veniam imploret, et gratiae tuae nobis dona conciliet.
Per Dominum.

propers.name: Postcommunion
propers.text:
Caelesti alimonia refecti, supplices te, Domine, deprecamur: ut beatae
Angelae precibus et exemplo, ab omni labe mundati, et corpore tibi placeamus
et mente. Per Dominum.
